Slides, handouts, and background documents from UC OSPO Network talks and workshops.

Looking for something else? Upcoming meetups and workshops are on the [Events page](https://ucospo.net/events/), and templates and how-to guides are on the [Resources page](https://ucospo.net/oss-resources/).

## Book

::: {.resource-card}
### UC Open Source: A System History

How UC research software went from BSD Unix to Jupyter, Ceph, Spark, RISC-V, and beyond, and what that history means for supporting open source today.

[Read the book](https://ucospo.net/network-docs/history) · [Source](https://github.com/UC-OSPO-Network/network-docs/tree/main/history)
:::

## Working documents

Accessibility audits, meeting agendas, and planning drafts, mostly for people working on the network. They live on GitHub: [reports](https://github.com/UC-OSPO-Network/network-docs/tree/main/reports) · [drafts](https://github.com/UC-OSPO-Network/network-docs/tree/main/drafts)
